findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 198 requests to 48 third-party domains (median of 2 passes).

81 cookies were set by third-party domains (112 cookies in total).
The address redirected 1 time(s): https://www.telegraph.co.uk/ -> https://www.telegraph.co.uk/us/

With the EasyPrivacy filter list applied (domain rules only, 47222 rules), 49 requests were blocked. The page still made 198 requests to 48 third-party domains, including 31 tracking services in our list.
